name: AxEMU
tagline: Next-gen US EVA suit, to be tested on Artemis III
description: Axiom Space's contracted EVA suit for NASA's Artemis lunar return. Heritage from the EMU but with mobility joints comparable to Apollo's A7LB, a regenerable amine CO₂ scrubber, HD video in the helmet, and dust-resistant joints for lunar surface use. Outer-layer styling by Prada. In qualification testing; to be tested in Earth orbit on Artemis III (2027) and worn on the Moon from Artemis IV.
best_known_for: Next-generation US EVA suit, to be worn on the first Artemis landing (Artemis IV)
